title: Three Springs and One Short Coop
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：hen　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hen 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the breeder ① fed the hen that no visitor in the farmyard would have counted, and he said the feeding was the whole of the spring. The ② hen, meaning the bird itself and not the coop, ran three springs and stayed uncounted in the book; a hen, he said, is the only thing in a farmyard that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ hen in that farmyard had the same short coop beside it, and the ④ hen at the far ditch, meaning the brood they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hen, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the breeder said the counting is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hen was the whole of the matter, meaning the living and not the bird. The ⑥ hen, meaning the living and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; hen, he said, is either something you feed or the only word that means both a bird and a living. He said the living is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ hen had become a line in a book, and the book had become an argument about the short coop. The ⑧ hen of the whole thing, the breeder wrote in February, was one farmyard and three springs of counting; hen, he said, is either the brood at the far ditch or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hen I remember is the bird counted in the book, which closed in 1966 and is still counted as the quietest in the farmyard. A ⑩ hen, my mother said in 1968, is the only bird that improves by being counted; every hen, she said, is a living that has agreed to look like a bird. She said the living was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 母鸡（指农家院里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 母鸡（指那只家禽本身，与鸡笼相对）
C. 固定搭配：feed the hen 喂鸡
D. n. 母鸡（指留给孩子们喂的那一只那一只）
E. n. 鸡事（抽象总称，指一处农家院的母鸡之事）
F. n. 母鸡（指账本里写到、被数过的的那一只）
G. n. 生计、营生（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 营生（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fed the hen that no visitor in the farmyard would have counted
The hen, meaning the bird itself and not the coop
the hen at the far ditch

answers.why: feed the hen 意为“喂鸡”，1959 年那位饲养人把农家院里没有一位来客肯清点的一只母鸡做了一遍。
hen 意为“母鸡”，指那只家禽本身而不是鸡笼，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被清点。
hen 意为“母鸡”，指农家院里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一个矮矮的鸡笼。
hen 意为“母鸡”，指最远那条水沟留给孩子们喂的那一只那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hen 意为“生计、营生”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份营生就是那件事的全部。
hen 意为“营生”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只家禽，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hen 意为“母鸡”，指账本里写到、被数过的的那一只，到 1964 年这一只成了账本里的一行。
hen 意为“鸡事”，饲养人二月写道，整件事的母鸡之事是一处农家院和三个春天的清点。
hen 意为“母鸡”，我记得的是账本里清点过的那一只，1966 年卖掉了，至今仍被说成农家院里最安静的一只。
hen 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，母鸡是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的家禽。
